steps.npc: All this mining is tiring work.

steps.player: But you're not even mining at the moment.

steps.npc: Hey! I've been mining all day thank you very much! I'm allowed a break ain't I?
I should think so. Anyway did you need anything?
Rocks? They're not rocks, they're minerals!

steps.player: Oh okay. What are they though?

steps.npc: Amethyst! We use it a lot back in Keldagrim but this is the only place we've managed to find it.

steps.player: What can I use it for?

steps.npc: We've found it's quite good for ranging ammunition, something you adventuring lot might like.
We use it a lot for Construction back in Keldagrim as well.

steps.player: Awesome! Does that mean I can use it in my house?

steps.npc: Because I said so that's why! Even the best human builders wouldn't know how to build with this stuff.

steps.text: If the player has under level 50 Construction:

steps.npc: And you're a long way off the best, believe me.
Well be on your way then. I've got mining to do!
